cards.text:
16-speaker VOID Acoustics system:
• Mains: 4× Stasys Xair (2 stacks L/R)
• Outboard subs: 2× Venu 215 V2
• Amps: 2× Bias V3 + Q2
• Signal processor: Drawmer SP2120
• Mixer: Allen & Heath CQ12
• Control: Armonía Pro Audio Suite
